`final class UniformBlock`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.uniform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UniformBlock.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/uniform/UniformBlock.java)

Holds every uniform value of a shader at its std140 offset, tracks which ones changed, and packs or hands them to the backend before a draw.

## Description

Each [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) owns one block, created by [`GlslShaderTranslator.createBlock`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/#GlslShaderTranslator-method-createBlock) from the uniforms of both stages.
`IShader.uniform` writes the values of the shader author, [`Shader.builtins`](/reference/bridges/shader/#Shader-method-builtins) writes those of JOID, and the backend sends them as its [`UniformLayout`](/reference/pipeline/uniformlayout/) requires.

## Learn more

- [Pick a uniform layout](/build/shader-translation/#pick-a-uniform-layout)

## Creation details

<a id="UniformBlock-factory-create"></a>

### create

`UniformBlock create(List<ShaderVariable> variables, String code)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Lays out the variables one after the other with the std140 rules and allocates the buffer, rounded up to a multiple of 16 bytes and at least 16 bytes.
`code` is the GLSL of both stages, where JOID reads the `#define` that gives an array length written as a name.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` for a type outside [`UniformType`](/reference/pipeline/uniformtype/) or a length that is neither a number nor a `#define`.

## Method details

<a id="UniformBlock-method-value"></a>

### value

`this value(String name, boolean value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes a boolean into the member `name`.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the block has no such member, or when the member is not a single `bool` or `int`.

`this value(String name, int... values)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes integers into the member `name`; a float member receives them as floats.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the block has no such member, or when the count does not fit its type.

`this value(String name, float... values)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes floats into the member `name`.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the block has no such member, when the member stores integers, or when the count does not fit its type.

<a id="UniformBlock-method-pack"></a>

### pack

`boolean pack()` 

Copies the changed members into `getData()` at their offsets, matrix columns and array elements on their strides, and marks them as sent.
Returns `true` when at least one member changed, so that the backend knows whether to upload the buffer again.

<a id="UniformBlock-method-upload"></a>

### upload

`this upload(Consumer<UniformMember> uploader)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Gives each changed member to `uploader`, then marks it as sent.

<a id="UniformBlock-method-requireMember"></a>

### requireMember

`UniformMember requireMember(String name)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The shader declares no builtin uniform …: JOID declares its joid_ uniforms only where they are used, translate the shader with stencil(...) for the stencil ones (uniforms: …)
- `IllegalArgumentException`: The shader declares no uniform …, declare it in the shader source or fix its name (uniforms: …)

Returns the member called `name`.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` with the names of the block when it has none.

<a id="UniformBlock-method-getData"></a>

### getData

`ByteBuffer getData()` 

Returns the std140 buffer, in native byte order, that `pack()` fills.
